contexts.text: Full of all violence and hostility against truth and good. Signified.
Then evils break out, either by arts, or by hostilities.
It is enmity, which continually breathes hostility and violence.
That the zeal or mercy of the Lord, when protecting the good, appears as hostility. Illustrated. AC 8875:5.
These evils are... enmity and hostility against those who do not favour self...
They had been in the love of the world, and in the derivative evils of various kinds, which are, enmity, hostility...
The evils with those who are in the love of dominating from the love of self are in general these... enmity against those who do not favour self, the consequent hostility...
When the Hells have been opened, there manifestly break out contempt, hostility and hatred with abuse against the Lord and against the holy things of Heaven and the Church...
